description: Variable-length edge with open lower bound (omitted / null min_hops).

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person)-[r:KNOWS*1..3]->(f:Person) RETURN p.name $$) AS ("name" agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") -[r IS "KNOWS"]->{1,3} (f IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") -[r IS "KNOWS"]->{1,3} (f IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name))
